643-3510-4288-6291.easyPrerequisites: You can cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
643-3510-4288-6291.description:
Cause a creature or land to enter under your control.
Each creature or land that entered is a Saproling through Maskwood Nexus and a Forest in addition to its other types due to and Life and Limb, causing Sarinth Greatwurm to trigger that many times.
Resolve a Sarinth Greatwurm trigger, creating the stated artifact tokens plus at least one creature token through Stridehangar Automaton.
Repeat steps 2-3. Unless you have a way to remove one of the pieces, this will cause an infinite mandatory loop and draw the game.

1339-1832-2034-5332.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
1339-1832-2034-5332.description:
Activate Unfulfilled Desires by paying {1} and 1 life, causing you to loot.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding {C}{C}
When the Insect dies, Carmen triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Carmen.
Repeat.

1453-4659-4694-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
1453-4659-4694-7306.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it, adding {C}{C}.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Arwen.
Repeat from step 1.

1479-2841-7892-8105.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Escape Tunnel.
1479-2841-7892-8105.description:
Fetch a land using Escape Tunnel.
When the fetched land enters, Thranduil the Strategist and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Thranduil the Strategist trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Thranduil the Strategist from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Thranduil the Strategist triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

4659-5086-5183-6996-7824.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
4659-5086-5183-6996-7824.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 1.

443-2292-2946-4871.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
443-2292-2946-4871.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Magus of the Bridge trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Avatar Kuruk

2665-7009-7752.manaNeeded: {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn available
2665-7009-7752.description:
Activate either Progenitor Mimic or Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Progenitor Mimic triggers, creating a token copy of Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat using the Avatar Kuruk token.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 7 or greater

5090-7704.description:
Activate Doc Samson by tapping it, adding at least seven mana of any color
Activate Singing Bell Strike by paying {6}, untapping Doc Samson.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5147-6972-7640.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Reputable Merchant.
When Reputable Merchant dies, its innate ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the Reputable Merchant trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Reputable Merchant from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Reputable Merchant enters, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

856-5256-5776-7396.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Quintorius, History Chaser trigger.
Resolve the Quintorius, History Chaser trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

1308-1558-2638-3257-4231.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1308-1558-2638-3257-4231.description:
Play Rakdos Carnarium.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters, it and Tireless Tracker trigger
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Anointed Procession.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3967-6972-7234.easyPrerequisites: There are a total of at least two cards in all hands.
3967-6972-7234.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Realm Seekers.
When Realm Seekers dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

413-1687-6888.description:
Cast Traveling Plague by paying {3}{B}{B}, attaching it to another creature you control.
When Traveling Plague enters, Siona triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature Traveling Plague is attached to.
When the creature dies, Traveling Plague triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token created in step 2.
Repeat steps 2 and 3 once.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 4

2781-5256-6767.description:
Cast Felidar Guardian by paying its mana cost.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Rescue Skiff
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Felidar Guardian.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian ability, blinking Rescue Skiff
When Rescue Skiff enters, it triggers, returning Felidar Guardian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1456-2464-3713-5078.notablePrerequisites: Song of Freyalise's first or second chapter ability has triggered this turn.
1456-2464-3713-5078.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

1682-2366-4359-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
1682-2366-4359-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Dictate of Karametra triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

3490-4017-4050-6458.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to gain life.
Thunder of Unity's second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
3490-4017-4050-6458.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Thunder of Unity triggers, causing you to gain life and each opponent to lose life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Sunbond attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

413-3661-4053-6989.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Shield Sphere.
Cast Shield Sphere from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
When Shield Sphere enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

5220-5256-6535-6900.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Serrated Scorpion.
When Serrated Scorpion dies, it and Mortuary triggers.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Serrated Scorpion from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Serrated Scorpion trigger, causing you to gain 2 life and dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Cast Serrated Scorpion from the top of your library by paying 1 life due to Gwenom.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature that does not have summoning sickness

uses.exileCardState: exiled by Steward of the Harvest

1268-3573-6474.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four artifacts.
1268-3573-6474.description:
Activate the creature with Crab Umbra attached using Tolarian Academy's ability by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Crab Umbra by paying {2}{U}, untapping the creature.
Repeat.

3951-4192-5703-6441.easyPrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr
3951-4192-5703-6441.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker, triggering its ability, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it and creating two tapped and attacking copies of Éomer.
Put all but one Éomer token into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing you to get at least one Éomer trigger, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, Altaïr triggers, causing you to exile the Éomer token.
Repeat each combat phase.

1580-2511-4871-5111.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat.

4871-6291-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
4871-6291-6495.notes: You may kill Evereth and pay for its trigger to have it deal damage to each opponent once the combo concludes.

1-1742-2275-6282.notablePrerequisites:
You have a card in hand.
Your life total is at least 2.
1-1742-2275-6282.description:
Activate Skirge Familiar by discarding a card, adding {B}.
Containment Construct triggers, exiling the discarded card with the ability to play it until end of turn.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Shabraz triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Shabraz.
Repeat.

56-443-5256-6248.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional untapped black and/or green creature.
56-443-5256-6248.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Hogaak.
When Hogaak dies, Magus of the Bridge and Phenomenon Investigators trigger, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill eight cards.
Cast Hogaak from your graveyard by exiling five cards from your graveyard and tapping two black and/or green creatures you control.
Repeat.
56-443-5256-6248.notes: Once you've milled your library, you may repeat the loop as the number of cards in your graveyard allows and decide to mill another player.

997-2281-5756.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Havi.
When Saffi dies, Havi triggers, returning any legendary creature card with mana value 1 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Saffi ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Havi.
When Havi dies, it and Saffi trigger.
Resolve the Havi trigger, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Saffi trigger, returning Havi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

3490-4981-5231.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
3490-4981-5231.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Serra Redeemer triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on the Servo.
Animation Module triggers, holding priority, activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat from step 3.

2558-5123-5330-5687.notablePrerequisites: You control no more than two additional creatures.
2558-5123-5330-5687.description:
Activate Atog by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield as a 1/1 due to Jetmir, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Eldrazi Spawn.
Resolve the Atog ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

1872-2136-2178.notablePrerequisites:
Orthion does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Orthion.
1872-2136-2178.description:
Activate Orthion's first ability by paying {1}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Composite Golem with haste.
Activate the Composite Golem token by sacrificing it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
When the Composite Golem token dies, Orthion triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

1017-1656-2335-4971.notablePrerequisites:
Wizard Class is level three.
Necrotic Ooze does not have summoning sickness.
1017-1656-2335-4971.description:
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Niv-Mizzet's ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card.
Wizard Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Necrotic Ooze.
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Barrenton Medic's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.

678-3263-4497-4853.notablePrerequisites: Slobad does not have summoning sickness.
678-3263-4497-4853.description:
Activate Slobad by tapping it and sacrificing Dross Scorpion, adding {4} that can only be spent to cast artifact spells or to activate abilities of artifacts.
Dross Scorpion dies, triggering itself and Enduring Renewal.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Slobad.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Dross Scorpion from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Dross Scorpion by paying {4}.
Repeat.

1996-4050-5003.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Brood Monitor, adding {1}.
Brood Monitor dies, triggering Nim Deathmantle, causing you to pay {4} to return Brood Monitor from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Brood Monitor enters the battlefield, creating three 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing three Eldrazi Scions, adding {3}.
Repeat.

578-1283-3525.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Metalworker.
Metalworker does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least one artifact card in hand.
578-1283-3525.description:
Activate Metalworker by tapping it and revealing at least one artifact card from your hand, adding at least {2}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {1}, untapping Metalworker.
Repeat.

618-4050-4242-4499.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping itself, creating a token copy of Su-Chi.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing copy of Su-Chi, adding one mana of any color.
Su-Chi triggers, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat.

3360-4474-4684.description:
Equip Paradise Mantle onto Torchling.
Tap Torchling to add {R}.
Spend that mana to untap Torchling, mill 1.
Repeat.

4270-4423-4872.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three additional Islands.
4270-4423-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}, getting an extra turn after this one.
Play Mystic Sanctuary to put Time Warp on top of your library.
Activate Trade Routes' first ability by paying {1}, returning Mystic Sanctuary to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Repeat.
